More places to explore

Old-web directories and search tools

These outside directories help you discover more old personal pages, classic web directories, archived captures, and small-web search results beyond this collection.

Why these?

They are useful for finding old websites, browsing human-edited directories, and exploring retro or independent web pages without needing to know the exact URL first.

Old'aVista

Searches old personal websites from hosts like GeoCities, Angelfire, AOL Hometown, Xoom, and Tripod.

Open

A lightweight search engine focused on older-style pages and the early-web browsing feeling.
